hero.title: What if three minutes could change how someone lives their day?

parallax.title: Three minutes.
parallax.p4: Before carrying the weight of the day home.

tension.title: What if those three minutes changed something?
tension.p1: Maybe someone chooses to listen instead of responding.
tension.p4: Maybe a decision is made more wisely.
tension.p5: Maybe someone finds the courage to keep going.
tension.p6: Maybe someone realizes they need to change.
tension.conclusion1: We don't know which life will be reached.
tension.conclusion2: But we know every life matters.

minimal.conclusion1: Big changes don't always start with big events.
minimal.conclusion2: Sometimes they start with one person who decided to pause for three minutes.

monumental.title: Imagine 100,000 people dedicating 3 minutes a day to reflect on what really matters.
monumental.subtitle: That's 300,000 minutes of daily reflection.
monumental.intro: But the mission was never about numbers.
monumental.core: It's about what happens after those three minutes:
monumental.final1: Because we don't just want to reach people.
monumental.final2: We want to transform how they live.

closing.final1: Maybe the next person is someone you will never meet.

about.p1: A space created to slow down, reflect, and look at life with more clarity.
about.p2: Every day, you'll find a new reflection on themes that are part of real life — choices, relationships, work, purpose, and faith.
about.p3: The proposal is simple: a few minutes a day to pause, think, and transform a reflection into practical action.
about.p4: You don't need to do much. Just be present for a few minutes.
about.p5: Access once a day, read, reflect, and take with you what makes sense for your day.
about.p6: The experience also works offline. For easier access, add the app to your home screen.
